A fully checked 455-column oriented unit triangular minor proves d3 surjectivity on the integral 2-cycle lattice. The 192 four-cells have oriented boundary rows forming the transpose of the incidence of a connected graph with 480 edges, giving primitive rank191 and kernel Z. Hence dual integral H3=Z^34,H4=Z, and 2-connectivity plus 3-skeleton attachments proves wedge S3^34 vee S4. Integral Alexander duality on sixteen vertices yields original H9=Z,H10=Z^34; finite verifier and actual output are embedded.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural exact integral homology and dual homotopy calculation for the unique five-regular strongly regular (16,5,0,2) graph, at the first adjacent ordinary cut parameter after an established torsion-bearing ordinary three-cut result. It yields two nontrivial, non-top free homology ranks and explicit nonshellability, and identifies a connected orientable 192-pentagon incidence structure carrying an integral four-dimensional fundamental class. It is not an arbitrary graph slice or an unmotivated normalization check.
